geometry: A 112 by 11 canvas with outlined white CPU lettering, approximately 17 by 7 units, and a translucent gradient meter well spanning x=21 to 108.5 and y=2 to 9 with a curved right end. The SVG was rendered at native size and 8x; the 8x rendering was visually inspected.
limitations: The tiny original lettering and meter gradient are approximated with smooth vector contours and gradient stops; their native antialiasing and opacity may differ from the raster.
